text:
You give the order to disconnect the Omega core governing $marketName.

The reply arrives before the order has finished sending. It is not a refusal. It is a forecast: how many people $marketName holds, how many decisions a second it takes to keep them fed, housed and alive, and how many minds in the Sector can make them. The last number is one.

A colony this size is too big to be governed by a lesser mind. Without the Omega core, $marketName will fall to anarchy.
options:
aar_civilwar_remove:Order the Omega core removed anyway
aar_civilwar_keep:Leave the Omega core in control
notes: Shown instead of the base game's rogue AI dialog when the colony is past size 10.

text:
The forecast is specific. The districts turn on each other within days. The Great Civil War that follows will leave $marketName at size 8, with an armed, ungoverned population living in the ruins.

The Omega core itself will be returned to you.
options:
aar_civilwar_confirm:Confirm the order
aar_civilwar_keep:Leave the Omega core in control

notes: override: the base game returns the core and adds no rogue AI.
